transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I keep losing interest in the projects and activities I usually care about, even when everything in my life is going fine. It's gotten to the point where I just can't bring myself to work on my landscaping designs or art anymore, and it's starting to affect my life.
Have you also noticed a decrease in pleasure or interest in almost all activities most of the day, nearly every day, not just your hobbies?

Yes, it definitely goes beyond hobbies. During these low spells, which have been happening on and off for about a year now, I completely lose interest in my park design work and even end up bailing on hikes and plans with my girlfriend. I just stop caring about almost everything and can't make myself stay engaged.
How long do these low mood periods usually last when they happen? Have any lasted continuously for at least two weeks?

Yes, they definitely last much longer than two weeks. This current low spell where I'm dragging and uninterested has actually been hanging around in some form for most of the past year. These longer low stretches have been happening off and on for about a year now.
Have you ever had a period of normal mood between these low episodes, even if just for a few weeks, or have your symptoms been present almost continuously throughout the past year?

It's been pretty much continuous over the past year, with very little normal time. I mostly alternate between these long, heavy low spells and brief, high-energy phases that only last for a few days. There really hasn't been much room in between for what I'd call a normal or stable mood.
During those brief high-energy phases, did you feel unusually energetic, need less sleep, or act more impulsively — signs of a manic or hypomanic episode?

Yes, during those times I feel unusually amped up and buzzing with energy, waking up early without feeling tired at all. My thoughts race so fast it's hard to sleep, and I've definitely made impulsive purchases, like charging expensive camping gear and art supplies to my credit card without checking my budget.
Have any of those high-energy, impulsive phases lasted for four days or longer, or were they shorter than that?
They usually last for just a few days, typically around three or four days at a time. After that, the high energy starts to fade and I transition back into one of my low spells.
